items:
Welcome to "Seaglass" - your soon to be favorite vacation home! If you've been seeking an experience like no other, look no further! This stunning 5 bedroom 5.5 bath home has it all! From various seating areas and entertainment zones, to upscale and newly remodeled decor, the interior of this home will leave you wanting for nothing. It is conveniently located in one of the premiere gated neighborhoods of 30A - just a golf cart or bike ride away from the many stores and beaches this beautiful area has to offer!

*Private beach access
*6-seat golf cart
*Exclusive Watersound West gated community with a resort pool
*Located on one of the serene lake close to the Gulf
*The downstairs lakeside screened porch features an outdoor kitchen, grill, dining area, and TV lounge area
*The upstairs area boasts unforgettable views and a swinging bed for ultimate comfort
*The 1st floor master bedroom features a lovely library and desk
*The 2nd floor master has a kitchenette
*Newly remodeled kitchen with a gas range, custom tile backsplash, and shelving
*All bedrooms have ensuite bathrooms and large TVs for entertainment
*Electric Fireplace in the living room
*Large laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer for convenience
*8 dining seats at the dinner table and additional seats at the breakfast bar
*Minimum age to rent is 25

Golf Cart Policy: Please note that we will need a card on file, a copy of your driver's license, and proof of insurance to be received per cart before your arrival.

Watersound West is ideally located in the heart of 30A. Our house is 0.7 miles from the Old Florida Fish House and Buddy’s seafood market, 1.7 miles from The Hub, 5 miles from Rosemary Beach, and 4 miles from Seaside, and close to Deer Lake State Park beach access.

Starter Pack: We provide our guests with a starter amenity pack of Gilchrist & Soames hand and body soaps, shampoo, conditioner, lotion, toilet paper, trash can liners, paper towels, dish soap, dishwasher pods, dish sponges, coffee packs, and laundry detergent pods. Once the initial amenities are depleted, guests are responsible for supplying their own amenities.

Cancellation Policy: 100% refund when bookings are cancelled 60 days (or more) before the start of the stay. Bookings canceled between 59 and 30 days before the start of stay will receive a 50% refund. For your protection, we encourage you to procure Traveler’s Insurance. Guests are required to electronically sign the rental agreement within TWO days of booking; otherwise, the reservation is subject to cancellation.

The Beyond Blue Difference: Our vacation homes are maintained above and beyond industry standards to remove any worry and make your stay with us an ideal, memorable vacation. Each home is professionally cleaned, services verified, and inspected before each guest's arrival. Our guest service team is available 7 days a week to help you before and during your stay.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located on a lake, this vacation home is in WaterSound Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Grayton Beach State Park. Traveling with kids? Consider Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park. Jet skiing and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with horse riding and hiking nearby.
